officialRules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf; Tallon Roll errata and Implied Target Rule
scope: Real Tallon Roll actions, sequential destiny, failed draws, ties, both winners, Corellian Slip modes, A Few Maneuvers/Dark Maneuvers just-drawn responses, unpiloted opponent and partial resolution after target departure. Includes a Tallon Roll during the battle weapons segment.
method: Board, pilot seats, Force and Reserve order are controlled. Interrupt plays, destiny draws and ship losses execute in production GEMP. All sixteen complete rows compare native commands after serialization.

Target departure is a controlled move to hand during actual initiation/draw responses. Both destiny draws still occur. A departed permanently-piloted Y-wing retains printed power for this comparison; its remaining opponent can still lose. Native follows the observed partial-effect behavior.
The initiating draw targets TIE maneuver, plus defending maneuver under Corellian Slip. The defending draw does not grant either maneuver response.
limitations: Component coverage; full native match admission stays closed. Sectors and larger model/card catalogs are not admitted by this checkpoint.

Saved-state corruption, nested Sense cancellation, repeated Slip copies, replacement-instance protection, crew/weapon ordering, pilot ability boundaries and browser recovery have additional native-only tests.
Tallon Roll calculation-total modifiers, other ship-targeting protections, complete ship statistic resets, further space/capture/Objectives/setup and full engine/product scope remain.
